title: Notes on Kozma and Nitzan's proof of $θ(p_c)=0$
summary: We present a human intelligible proof of the conjectures of Kozma and Nitzan, that they used to show $θ(p_c)=0$. The proof was recently found by AI, but was very poorly written. Our version is much shorter as it completely skips the horizontal term and its long estimate.
